findings.title: Income eligibility
findings.summary: The income ceiling is described by the official portal. One secondary source gives a different figure without identifying the cycle.
findings.value: Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh

sources.quote: The annual income of parents / guardians from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Applicants must have a family income below Rs. 2 lakh per year.

findings.note: The official portal is the primary source for this scheme. The blog does not state which application cycle its figure applies to.

findings.title: Required income document
findings.summary: The official portal and one guide describe different supporting documents. Confirm the accepted document for this applicant category.

sources.quote: A valid income certificate issued by the competent authority must be uploaded with the application.
Students should keep the latest ITR acknowledgement ready during document verification.

findings.note: These statements may refer to different applicant situations. Do not treat them as interchangeable until the current scheme instructions are checked.

findings.title: Application deadline
findings.summary: A source gives a deadline from the previous cycle. No current closing date was found in the supplied readable sources.

sources.quote: The last date for submitting the online application is 30 November 2025.

findings.note: The date is explicitly associated with the 2025–26 cycle and should not be reused for 2026–27.

findings.title: Renewal rules
findings.summary: None of the successfully analysed sources explains the renewal conditions for the next academic year.
findings.note: Check the official scheme guidelines or contact the scheme authority before assuming renewal is automatic.

findings.title: Additional department guidance
findings.summary: One supplied website could not be read automatically, so its guidance could not be checked.
findings.value: Could not verify from blocked source
findings.note: The Education Updates page blocked automated access. Paste its text or review it manually before relying on any additional requirements.

findings.title: Scholarship amount
findings.summary: A benefit amount is mentioned in the official scheme information and institutional notice.
findings.value: Amount varies by course and category

sources.quote: The scholarship amount will be disbursed as per the applicable scheme rate and course category.
Eligible students will receive benefits according to the notified course-wise rates.

findings.note: The sources agree at a high level, but the exact payable amount depends on course and category.
